description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。可能的值：

- true：发送请求，不创建服务实例。

- false：发送请求，检查通过后创建服务实例。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for the request. The dry run checks for permissions, the instance status, and other items. Valid values:

- true: Sends a dry run request. The deployment of the service instance does not continue.

- false: Sends a regular request. The deployment of the service instance continues after the request passes the check.
The configuration parameters of the service instance.
The ID of the service instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier continue-deploy-service-instance --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --service-instance-id si-0e6fca6a51a544200000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --parameters NodeCount_:_3,_SystemDiskSize_:_40,_InstancePassword_:_000000 --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
